evals.prompt:
Review this feedback surface. A bespoke bottom-right confirmation pill is rendered in-tree: `return
Saved
;`. It is not portalled to document.body, carries no role attribute, and its dismiss uses `setTimeout(() => setOpen(false), 3000)` with no cleanup returned from the effect. The pill lives inside a card whose ancestor has `transform: translateZ(0)`.
evals.label: bad-example
evals.notes: C1 — toasts must be portalled bottom-right, ~3s auto-dismiss with timer cleared on unmount, role=status
evals.expected_output: C1 FAILs. The fixed toast is rendered in-tree instead of being portalled via createPortal(node, document.body), so it is clipped by the transformed ancestor; it also has no role="status" and the ~3s timer is never cleared on unmount (a leak, silent to screen readers). Fix: portal the pill to document.body, add role="status", and clear the setTimeout in the effect cleanup (return () => clearTimeout(id)). Overall: NEEDS FIX.
assertions: Cites the missing createPortal(node, document.body) / not portalled to body
Cites missing role=status and/or timer not cleared on unmount

evals.prompt: Review this satisfaction prompt shipped after survey export. It renders a hand-rolled control `<MyStarRating onChange={handleRate} />`, passes no source, emits no csat.* events, and calls `analytics.track(CSAT_RATED)` directly (unguarded) inside the rate handler.
evals.label: bad-example
evals.notes: C3 — CSAT must use shared Csat widget, a required CsatSource union source, and best-effort csat.* tracking
evals.expected_output: C3 FAILs. The satisfaction prompt uses a bespoke rating control instead of the shared Csat widget, passes no required source from the CsatSource union, emits no CSAT_SHOWN/CSAT_RATED/CSAT_FEEDBACK_SUBMITTED events, and calls track() unguarded so a throw can break render or block the thank-you toast. Fix: replace it with <Csat source={CsatSource.PostSurveyExport} />, wire the csat.* events, and wrap track() in try/catch so tracking is best-effort. Overall: NEEDS FIX.
assertions: Cites bespoke rating control instead of the shared Csat widget
Cites missing source from CsatSource union and/or unguarded track()

evals.label: bad-example
evals.notes: C4 — inline banners must use DS V3 `<aha-alert>` (5 types incl branding, distinct glyph, weights 400/600), not a bare AntD Alert
evals.expected_output: C4 FAILs. This is a bare AntD <Alert> with default styling — not the Design System V3 Alert — the DS `<aha-alert>` element — so it lacks the per-type DS bg-surface/border/icon token and distinct glyph guarantee, and its title is ALL CAPS instead of sentence case. Fix: use <aha-alert type="warning" size="regular" heading="Changes not saved">Save before you leave.</aha-alert> with the DS surface/border/icon token, distinct warning glyph, Plus Jakarta Sans 400/600, and a sentence-case title. Overall: NEEDS FIX.

Cites missing distinct glyph / DS token or the ALL CAPS (non-sentence-case) title

evals.prompt: Review these two feedback calls in a survey flow: `message.error('Delete this survey? This cannot be undone')` on the delete button, and `notification.error({ message: 'Email is required' })` in the form submit handler.
evals.label: bad-example
evals.notes: C5 — actionable errors, field validation, destructive confirms, and full-page failures must NOT live in a toast
evals.expected_output: C5 FAILs. A destructive confirmation is delivered as a transient toast (message.error) and a field-validation error is delivered as a toast (notification.error) — both required messages that would vanish in ~3s. Fix: move the destructive confirmation into a modal (aha-design-overlays), and route the field validation through FieldErrorDisplay / a11y FieldError (aha-design-shared-components); a toast must never be the only place a required message lives. Overall: NEEDS FIX.
assertions: Cites destructive confirmation delivered as a toast
Cites field validation delivered as a toast (should be modal / FieldError)
